correctness.rationale: For normalized eigenbasis x∼v1+t v2, exact Rayleigh quotient μ=(λ1+λ2t²)/(1+t²) and inverse iteration give t+ = −t³. Starting cone is −tanθ<t<cotθ, mapped-positive condition is −cuberoot(cotθ)<t<cuberoot(tanθ), giving the intersection. Universal positive-ray invariance implies tanθ=cotθ=1, equivalent to a=d. Independent rational elimination for A=[[1,−1],[−1,2]], x=(1,4) gives μ=25/17 and y=(−1309/361,255/361), and satisfies basin condition. This covers eigenvector termination, sign orientation, and equal-diagonal cubic convergence.
residual_risks: Only 2×2 irreducible SPD Stieltjes exact arithmetic; eigenvector sign is a ray convention.
